summary: Mega Matrix Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting held September 1, 2026. Shareholders approved a 20-for-1 share consolidation of class A, B, and C ordinary shares, effective September 15, 2026, with fractional shares rounded up. Authorized share capital was adjusted accordingly, and amended articles were adopted. The filing is a routine corporate action announcement, not a special situation. Watch for post-consolidation trading adjustments and potential Nasdaq compliance implications; no strategic events were disclosed.
